answer.explanation: Order is a domain entity holding business logic (adding lines, validating quantity), but it imports the Entity decorator from typeorm on line 1 and is annotated with @Entity(). That ties the domain model to a persistence framework and infrastructure concern. FF-DT04 flags this because the domain layer should stay free of framework and infrastructure packages. Persistence mapping belongs in an infrastructure adapter or a separate persistence model. The README only describes the context as a DDD service and states no rule or exception on this dependency.
